authorization: Explicit user authorization 2026-10-01 for revised R1 second stage N1024 only
stage: N1024 only; complete report and push, then stop
training_recipe: Actual P512 fresh construction, seed2026093001, data/loss/optimizer/selection unchanged; only N-dependent bottleneck and TX/RX shapes change; no communication weights or optimizer inherited
training_limit: first20000, possible30000/40000 only at frozen last-two-interval full-calibration gate
digital_reliability_reference: minimum header failure OR bodyCRC failure frame proportion; exact ties prefer larger m then fixed action ID
digital_quality_selection: each PHY and C/U independently: PSNR>=same-condition reliability-reference PSNR-.25dB; then minimum LPIPS, ties lower failure fraction then fixed action ID
header_failure: existing grey-image fallback, with event/erasure recorded
body_crc_failure: existing unverified raw decoded candidate prefix retained; trusted_last=0; no truth token replacement
source_class_origin: original registered ImageNet/application labels transmitted in the paid header; availability is an additional condition
unconditional_generation: verified unconditional VAR class embedding index1000; paid header length retained; no true or received class used for completion
generation: original frozen greedy completion; no sampling, CFG, beam or best-sample search
QPSK_energy_constraint: per-frame E=2N including header and body
16QAM_energy_constraint: original fixed constellation scaling, actual frame energy recorded; no per-frame normalization or free gain
decoder_reference: original D0 rerenders the identical selected digital latent and action; no D0 reselection

plugin.selection: same Step2 calibration error/fusion/LPIPS/BYPASS rules, independently recalibrated for P1024
plugin.lambda0: quantization/fusion candidate, same A1 result, distinct from true BYPASS
plugin.shared_observation: one N1024 P1024 waveform and AWGN observation per source/SNR/noise; no latent AWGN added

statistics.unit: source image, averaging three noise repeats first
statistics.H_D: same-Dc digital vs P1024; LPIPS delta<=-.02 and CIupper<0 OR DINO delta>=+.02 and CIlower>0 with positive source-specificity CI; report PSNR/F error tradeoffs without extra PSNR gate
statistics.H_R: one common quality branch must simultaneously exceed P1024/A1/A2; same amplitude/CI rules plus frozen PSNR feasibility; true BYPASS is not a gain

historical_budget_curves: reuse only identity-compatible completed points; missing points stay missing; no automatic historical matrix rerun
digital_latent_failure_accounting: Header failure preserves original RGB=0.5 and has no actual Fhat: latent_valid=false, decoder_applied=false, actual latent squared error empty/NaN; optional zero-erasure proxy is a separate diagnostic. Quality metrics and source bootstrap include all failures. Actual latent summaries are conditional on valid estimates with counts; paired latent differences use the valid intersection.
cross_budget_comparison: Compare digital-minus-continuous metric deltas at N1024 vs N512, paired by source after averaging the registered noise repeats. This is a single model per N on reused development, not training-seed replication.
